title: Atp6v0c loss exposes a selective V-ATPase vulnerability program that converges with Pitpna in thalamic glutamatergic neurons
exact_observed_result: Atp6v0c depletion was efficient in nearly all cell classes but produced most downstream FDR genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 052 Pvalb Gaba; in 151 TH it overlapped a Pitpna vulnerability branch involving calcium/synaptic genes, while Atp6v1b2 produced a smaller 052 Pvalb stress signature with Dusp1, Scg2, Gadd45g, and Ptprn induction.
biological_interpretation: The V0c proteolipid subunit creates a selective V-ATPase liability state, and partial convergence with Pitpna links vesicle/endolysosomal acidification to phosphoinositide/calcium stress in thalamic neurons.

source_findings.summary: Atp6v0c knockdown was broadly achieved but the downstream transcriptome was sharply concentrated in five neuronal groups.
source_findings.why_it_matters: HPA and UniProt describe ATP6V0C as broadly detected and central to V-ATPase biology, so the dataset argues that some neuronal cell classes are buffered at the mRNA level whereas TH Prkcd, Pvalb, midbrain glutamatergic, brainstem/midbrain GABAergic, and pineal/brainstem glutamatergic cells are transcriptionally vulnerable.
source_findings.cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut
source_findings.main_caveats: Significant rows are mRNA changes only; response size is not the same as loss of lysosomal acidification or neuronal firing defects.

source_findings.summary: Pitpna knockdown was measured across 22 neuronal classes, but FDR-scale downstream transcription was concentrated in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 217 P MY Pineal Glut, with a Jun-only significant response in 191 MB P MY GABA.
source_findings.why_it_matters: The response is not simply proportional to on-target knockdown or target expression; it points to a small set of vulnerable neuronal states for a broadly expressed lipid-transfer protein.
source_findings.cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
source_findings.main_caveats: Cell classes with small perturbed-cell counts may be underpowered, and the assay measures mRNA rather than acute lipid signaling.

source_findings.summary: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Pitpna loss suppressed Prkcg, Atp2a2, Ramp3, Gabra4, Lrrc7, Tubb3, and Tubb4b while inducing Scg2, Kctd16, Cnnm1, and Pip5kl1.
source_findings.why_it_matters: The directionally mixed but coherent signature connects a lipid-transfer perturbation to PKC/calcium handling and synaptic genes in a neuronal class relevant to the known neurodegenerative loss-of-function biology of Pitpna.
source_findings.main_caveats: The genes are transcript changes downstream of partial knockdown; the experiment did not directly measure phosphoinositides, PKC activity, cytosolic calcium, or neuronal firing.

source_findings.summary: Atp6v0c was not interchangeable with other assayed V-ATPase subunits: even robust Atp6ap1, Atp6ap2, or Atp6v0a1 transcript depletion produced far fewer FDR genes in the same responsive cell types.
source_findings.why_it_matters: The contrast preserves an unexpected perturbation-specific effect inside a complex that structural literature treats as an obligate assembly; V0c may be uniquely limiting, or the other subunit proteins may be buffered by slower turnover or weaker functional engagement.
source_findings.cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba
source_findings.main_caveats: The assay reports transcript knockdown; residual protein, gRNA potency, and subunit stoichiometry could differ across targets.

source_findings.direction: canonical transcripts mostly unchanged at FDR level
source_findings.summary: The Pvalb response was not a transcriptional induction of measured V-ATPase, Ragulator-mTORC1, or TFEB/MITF lysosome-biogenesis genes.
source_findings.why_it_matters: V-ATPase is embedded in lysosomal acidification, amino-acid sensing, and autophagy biology; the dataset instead highlights a compact neuronal/secretory and stress-response mRNA signature.
source_findings.main_caveats: The absence of mRNA changes does not test V-ATPase assembly, pump activity, lysosomal pH, autophagic flux, mTORC1 phosphorylation, or TFEB localization.

source_findings.direction: Atp6v1b2 down with a mixed downstream Pvalb signature
source_findings.summary: Atp6v1b2 loss produced a genome-wide FDR-resolved response only in 052 Pvalb Gaba.
source_findings.why_it_matters: ATP6V1B2 is a core proton-pump subunit with broad expected endolysosomal and synaptic-vesicle roles, but the dataset localizes the clearest loss-of-transcript consequence to Pvalb inhibitory neurons.
source_findings.cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
source_findings.main_caveats: Most non-Pvalb cell classes had fewer than 35 perturbed cells; this is an mRNA signature rather than a direct lysosomal-pH or synaptic-vesicle assay.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 23 cell types; on-target score negative in 23/23; target FDR <0.05 in 22/23; median on-target logFC -1.26, range -2.31 to -0.525. Strongest measurements included 155 MB Glut logFC -1.73, FDR 5.18e-45; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut logFC -1.43, FDR 1.04e-34; 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut logFC -1.21, FDR 3.96e-27.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The Atp6v0c transcript was directly measured and strongly depleted across almost every cell type.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 791 FDR<0.05 downstream genes after excluding Atp6v0c; 771/791, or 97.5%, were in five groups: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut 536; 052 Pvalb Gaba 157; 155 MB Glut 32; 191 MB P MY GABA 23; 217 P MY Pineal Glut 23. The other 18 groups each had <=6 downstream FDR genes.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The downstream transcriptional response to Atp6v0c knockdown was concentrated in a small subset of cell classes.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Pitpna transcript was present for 22 cell types; logFC was negative in 21/22 rows; median logFC -0.455, range -0.976 to 0.016; 5/22 rows had FDR<0.05 and 14/22 had nominal p<0.05.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Aggregate on-target readout for Pitpna perturbation across all measured cell types.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 189 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 21 FDR<0.05 genes including Pitpna; 20 FDR<0.05 non-target genes. Pitpna logFC -0.788 FDR 2.48e-16; Prkcg -0.376 FDR 5.90e-05; Atp2a2 -0.226 FDR 7.06e-04; Ramp3 -0.337 FDR 0.00579; Scg2 +0.358 FDR 0.0142; Gabra4 -0.224 FDR 0.0142; Kctd16 +0.285 FDR 0.0150; Pip5kl1 +0.564 FDR 0.0300.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The largest Pitpna downstream transcriptome was concentrated in the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 29 perturbed cells versus 3465 controls; 12 FDR<0.05 genes including Pitpna; Cadm3 logFC +0.637 FDR 0.0244; Ptprn +0.909 FDR 0.0244; Jun +2.207 FDR 0.0244; Crem +1.555 FDR 0.0244; Aifm3 -1.163 FDR 0.0244; Pitpna -0.808 FDR 0.0285; Cx3cl1 -0.848 FDR 0.0285; Grn +1.196 FDR 0.0285.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: A small but FDR-supported posterior glutamatergic response coupled immediate-early induction to altered neuron-to-glia signaling transcripts.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 74 perturbed cells versus 10309 controls; only Pitpna and Jun met FDR<0.05. Pitpna logFC -0.933 FDR 2.35e-05; Jun logFC +1.599 FDR 6.86e-05.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: A midbrain/pons/myelencephalon GABA class shared the Jun component of the posterior Pitpna response but had little additional FDR-supported transcriptomic remodeling.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 189 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 21 FDR<0.05 genes including Pitpna; 20 FDR<0.05 non-target genes. Pitpna logFC -0.788 FDR 2.48e-16; Prkcg -0.376 FDR 5.90e-05; Atp2a2 -0.226 FDR 7.06e-04; Ramp3 -0.337 FDR 0.00579; Scg2 +0.358 FDR 0.0142; Gabra4 -0.224 FDR 0.0142; Kctd16 +0.285 FDR 0.0150; Pip5kl1 +0.564 FDR 0.0300.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The largest Pitpna downstream transcriptome was concentrated in the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class.

evidence_ledger_rows.cell_type: 052 Pvalb Gaba and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Atp6v0c produced 537 FDR<0.05 genes, whereas Atp6ap1, Atp6ap2, Atp6v0a1, Atp6v1a, Atp6v1b2, and Atp6v1e1 produced respectively 2, 2, 1, 0, 0, and 0; Atp6ap1, Atp6ap2, and Atp6v0a1 themselves were strongly depleted, with own-transcript FDR 7.91e-28, 1.90e-28, and 4.52e-12. In 052 Pvalb Gaba, Atp6v0c produced 158 FDR genes whereas the six related perturbations produced 0-9 FDR genes.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Several V-ATPase complex or accessory subunit perturbations were present in the dataset but did not phenocopy Atp6v0c at transcriptome scale.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 64 perturbed versus 13,710 control cells; 9 genes at FDR<0.05. Atp6v1b2 logFC -0.694, score -5.885, p=3.98e-09, FDR=6.67e-05; Hcn3 logFC 0.994, FDR=0.00273; Dusp1 logFC 1.139, FDR=0.0114; Serpini1 logFC -0.727, FDR=0.0323; Scg2 logFC 0.861, FDR=0.0340; Gadd45g logFC 1.871, FDR=0.0402; Slc6a17 logFC 0.473, FDR=0.0490; Ptprn logFC 0.545, FDR=0.0490; Lpcat1 logFC 1.007, FDR=0.0490.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The only Atp6v1b2 cell class with multiple genome-wide FDR-significant genes was Pvalb GABA.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: In 052 Pvalb Gaba, all listed V-ATPase, Ragulator/Rag, mTOR, TFEB/MITF, lysosomal, and endosomal marker transcripts had FDR=1.0 except Ctsd, which had nominal p=0.0126 and FDR=0.884. Other measured V-ATPase genes were not FDR significant: Atp6v1a p=0.0644, Atp6v1e1 p=0.336, Atp6v0a1 p=0.595, Atp6v0c p=0.278, Atp6ap1 p=0.899, Atp6ap2 p=0.827.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The Pvalb response did not transcriptionally induce other measured pump subunits, mTORC1/Ragulator transcripts, or canonical lysosome-biogenesis regulators.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 14 Atp6v1b2 tests, 22-64 perturbed cells each; target logFC was negative in all 14. The target row reached FDR 6.67e-05 in 052 Pvalb Gaba, had nominal p<0.001 in 005, 022, 046, 052, and 308, and had nominal p<0.05 in 7/14 tests.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Direct on-target transcript quantification for every cell class in which an Atp6v1b2 perturbation was tested.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 64 perturbed versus 13,710 control cells; 9 genes at FDR<0.05. Atp6v1b2 logFC -0.694, score -5.885, p=3.98e-09, FDR=6.67e-05; Hcn3 logFC 0.994, FDR=0.00273; Dusp1 logFC 1.139, FDR=0.0114; Serpini1 logFC -0.727, FDR=0.0323; Scg2 logFC 0.861, FDR=0.0340; Gadd45g logFC 1.871, FDR=0.0402; Slc6a17 logFC 0.473, FDR=0.0490; Ptprn logFC 0.545, FDR=0.0490; Lpcat1 logFC 1.007, FDR=0.0490.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The only Atp6v1b2 cell class with multiple genome-wide FDR-significant genes was Pvalb GABA.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 64 perturbed versus 15,039 control cells, matching the Pvalb perturbed-cell count; Atp6v1b2 was the top-ranked gene by nominal p with logFC -0.580, score -4.053, p=5.06e-05, FDR=0.456. No gene reached FDR<0.05.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: A same-sample-size cortical glutamatergic class showed nominal on-target depletion but no FDR-resolved downstream transcriptome.

caveats: The screen measured mRNA rather than organelle pH, synaptic-vesicle filling, V-ATPase assembly, or lysosomal flux.
Other V-ATPase subunits had different guide strength and stoichiometric constraints, so weaker signatures are not proof those subunits are biologically dispensable.
